findings.problem: This diff undoes commit e11187e. That commit had replaced `Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True)` with a preconfigured `jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True)` passed as `env=`. Its stated reason was that Starlette removed the `**env_options` passthrough in newer versions. I read the installed Starlette (.venv/.../starlette/templating.py:84-116). In that version autoescape=True comes only from `_create_env`'s `env_options.setdefault("autoescape", True)`. pyproject.toml lists `fastapi` without an upper bound. Once a Starlette version drops `**env_options`, this line raises `TypeError` when the module is imported and the web UI fails to start. The old code set autoescape explicitly on an environment it built itself, so it held on every version. The new line relies on a deprecated keyword argument that the library forwards for now. pending: confirm the lockfile and Docker build pin a Starlette version that still accepts `**env_options`.
